## Attendance

The programme board met in February 2025. Present were J. Whitfield, S. Rahman, Priya Anand, R. Adeyemi, G. Evans. J. Whitfield chaired the meeting. Attendance was noted and there were no other matters raised under this item.

## Performance

The board reviewed activity and outstanding work for the reporting period. There were 2201 captures. The backlog stood at 233, and the number of letters was 55. Members noted the position and agreed that the figures should continue to be monitored through the programme’s routine reporting arrangements. Any material change in performance or emerging pressure should be brought to the board’s attention.

## Items

The board considered INC-0236 Merge batch reversed. The item was noted, with the owner expected to provide a further report on progress and any outstanding issues.

CHG-0240 Outreach camera firmware 3.1.0 was also considered. The board noted the change and requested a further report from the owner, including any relevant implementation updates.

## Actions

The owners of INC-0236 Merge batch reversed and CHG-0240 Outreach camera firmware 3.1.0 are to report back on progress. These actions will remain open and be carried forward to the next meeting. Performance information, including captures, backlog and letters, will also continue to be reviewed.
